description: Extend .github/workflows/release.yml to build all 4 platform native binaries + IDEA plugin zip on v* tags. Collects missing macos-13 Intel binary, adds Gradle plugin assembly job.

steps.label: Add macos-13 to release build matrix for Intel macOS binary
steps.old_string:
- os: macos-14
            artifact_glob: "dist/*.tar.gz"
            script: "bash scripts/package_release.sh"
          - os: windows-latest
steps.new_string:
- os: macos-14
            artifact_glob: "dist/*.tar.gz"
            script: "bash scripts/package_release.sh"
          - os: macos-13
            artifact_glob: "dist/*.tar.gz"

steps.label: Add IDEA plugin build job that collects all 4 platform binaries and runs gradle buildPlugin
steps.old_string:
publish-github-release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: release-artifacts
          merge-multiple: true

steps.new_string:
build-idea-plugin:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download all platform binaries
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Extract binaries from tar archives
        run: |
          for tgz in dist/*.tar.gz; do
            tar -xzf "$tgz" -C dist/
          done
          find dist/ -name flutterguard -o -name 'flutterguard.exe' | sort

      - name: Sync binaries into plugin resources
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
          mkdir -p idea-plugin/src/main/resources/bin
          for src in \
            "dist/flutterguard-${VERSION}-macos-arm64/flutterguard:idea-plugin/src/main/resources/bin/flutterguard-darwin-arm64" \
            "dist/flutterguard-${VERSION}-macos-x64/flutterguard:idea-plugin/src/main/resources/bin/flutterguard-darwin-x64" \
            "dist/flutterguard-${VERSION}-linux-x64/flutterguard:idea-plugin/src/main/resources/bin/flutterguard-linux-x64"; do
            IFS=':' read -r s d <<< "$src"
            if [[ -f "$s" ]]; then cp "$s" "$d" && chmod +x "$d" && echo "OK: $d"; else echo "WARN: missing $s"; fi
          done
          # Windows binary has .exe extension
          WIN_SRC="dist/flutterguard-${VERSION}-windows-x64/flutterguard.exe"
          if [[ -f "$WIN_SRC" ]]; then cp "$WIN_SRC" idea-plugin/src/main/resources/bin/flutterguard-windows-x64.exe && echo "OK: flutterguard-windows-x64.exe"; fi

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4

      - name: Build IDEA plugin
        env:
          PLUGIN_VERSION: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          cd idea-plugin
          ./gradlew buildPlugin

      - name: Upload plugin artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flutterguard-idea-plugin
          path: idea-plugin/build/distributions/*.zip

  publish-github-release:
    needs: [build, build-idea-plugin]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: release-artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: |
            release-artifacts/*.tar.gz
            release-artifacts/*.zip
          generate_release_notes: true

steps.label: Check YAML syntax of updated workflow
Verify CI workflow structure: 4 platforms in build matrix, plugin job, release job
steps.command:
cd /Users/forest/code/flutterguard && python3 -c "
import yaml
with open('.github/workflows/release.yml') as f:
    d = yaml.safe_load(f)
jobs = d['jobs']
# 1. build matrix has 4 entries
matrix = jobs['build']['strategy']['matrix']['include']
oses = [m['os'] for m in matrix]
assert 'macos-13' in oses, f'macos-13 missing: {oses}'
assert 'macos-14' in oses
assert 'ubuntu-latest' in oses
assert 'windows-latest' in oses
print(f'build matrix: {len(matrix)} platforms OK — {oses}')
# 2. build-idea-plugin job exists
assert 'build-idea-plugin' in jobs
print('build-idea-plugin job: present')
# 3. publish-github-release depends on both build + build-idea-plugin
pub_needs = jobs['publish-github-release']['needs']
assert 'build' in pub_needs and 'build-idea-plugin' in pub_needs
print(f'publish-github-release needs: {pub_needs}')
print('ALL CI CHECKS PASSED')
"

post_execution.trigger: Push a v* tag (e.g. v0.7.1) to trigger the release workflow.
post_execution.manual_publish: After release, download the flutterguard-idea-plugin artifact and upload to JetBrains Marketplace (or add publishPlugin step with token secret).
post_execution.jetbrains_first_time: Plugin listing must be created manually at https://plugins.jetbrains.com/ before CI can auto-publish.

what_changes.release.yml: adds macos-13 to build matrix + adds build-idea-plugin job (extract binaries, Gradle buildPlugin, upload artifact)
